usedFor: Shopify holds shoppers and carts, and NetHunt CRM keeps them as records through “Create Record”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Record” in NetHunt CRM
bestTemplate.why: Someone who gave contact details and left is a lead worth chasing, so a record opens for follow-up.

watchOut: “Update Record” changes a record that already exists, so run “Create Record” first or the update has nothing to change.
